X has become more than a place to post your thoughts. For Nigerian creators, founders, freelancers and professionals, it can be a place to build an audience, promote a business and connect with opportunities around the world. That is why features like X Premium can be useful. But when it is time to subscribe, how do you pay for X Premium in Nigeria?


The simplest option is to use a virtual dollar card that supports international payments, such as the Cleva Classic Card. You can create the card from your Cleva account, keep your funds in USD and use the card to pay for eligible international services like X Premium.


X currently offers Basic, Premium and Premium+ plans. On the web, pricing starts at $3 per month for Basic, $8 for Premium and $40 for Premium+, although the price you see can vary based on your location, taxes and payment method.


## **What is X Premium?**


X Premium is X’s paid subscription service. It gives subscribers access to additional features that are not available on the free version of X.


Depending on the plan you choose, these features can include:


- The ability to edit posts
- Longer posts and videos
- Reduced ads on some plans
- Reply prioritisation
- A blue checkmark for eligible Premium and Premium+ accounts
- Access to additional Grok features
- Creator and monetisation-related features
- More customisation options


X currently has three main consumer tiers: **Basic, Premium and Premium+** .


For Nigerian users who rely on X for networking, content creation, business or personal branding, Premium can be a useful upgrade.


The bigger question is how to pay for it.


## **Can you pay for X Premium with a Nigerian naira card?**


It depends on the card and how X processes the payment.


Some Nigerian naira cards may work for international online payments, while others may have restrictions on international or recurring transactions. Even when a card works for one international service, that does not guarantee it will work on another.


This is why many Nigerians looking for how to pay for X Premium in Nigeria turn to virtual dollar cards.


Instead of asking your naira card to handle a dollar-denominated international transaction, you can use a card designed for USD payments.


## **How to pay for X Premium in Nigeria with a virtual dollar card**


A virtual dollar card gives you a way to make eligible international payments in USD without waiting for a physical card.


The process is straightforward:

Choose a provider that offers a virtual dollar card that supports international online payments.


For Nigerians,[Cleva](http://www.getcleva.com/) is one of the strongest options because the Cleva Classic Card spends directly from your USD wallet. You do not need to fund the card separately before making a payment.


### 2. Make sure you have enough USD


Before subscribing to X Premium, check your Cleva USD wallet.


Your balance should cover the subscription price and any applicable taxes or charges shown by X.


This also helps prevent payment declines caused by insufficient funds.


### 3. Create your Cleva Classic Card


You can create the Cleva Classic Card directly from your Cleva account.


The card has a one-time $3 creation fee, with no separate card funding step required. Once created, your card details are available for online payments.


### 4. Go to X Premium


Open X and go to the Premium section.


You can subscribe through the X website or through the relevant mobile app flow where Premium is available. X’s official instructions allow users to select a Premium tier and proceed to payment.


### 5. Enter your Cleva card details


Select the Premium plan you want and enter your Cleva Classic Card details when X asks for your payment information.


You will typically need your:

A virtual dollar card is not the only possible payment method. Your available options can depend on your location, the X platform you use and the payment methods X presents at checkout.


### 1. Nigerian debit or credit card


Some Nigerian cards may work for international online payments. However, acceptance can vary by card issuer, transaction type and merchant.


If your regular card repeatedly fails, a USD card can provide another option.


### 2. App Store or Google Play payment

However, your available payment method can depend on your Apple or Google account’s payment setup and region.

## **What if your X Premium payment fails?**


If X rejects your payment, don’t immediately assume that the card doesn’t work.

**2. Check your card details.**

**3. Check your spending limit.**
Your Cleva Classic Card lets you set a transaction limit. Make sure the limit is high enough for the payment.


**4. Check the X payment flow.**

**5. Check whether X is available in your market.**
